headline: Nintendo Q2 Net Profit Drops as Switch 2 Unit Sales Slow
summary: Nintendo reported a drop in second-quarter net profit as sales of the Switch 2 console slowed, though the gaming giant maintained its full-year net profit forecast of ¥310 billion.
why: Quarterly hardware sales figures for major gaming console manufacturers reflect consumer demand trends and product lifecycle transitions.

impacts.name: Nintendo
impacts.why: Slowing hardware unit sales and lower quarterly profits can create downward pressure on the stock.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
